places.name: Double Decker Living Root Bridge, Nongriat
places.description: One of the most extraordinary examples of indigenous bioengineering in the world — a living structure that gets stronger with age.
places.mapsSearch: Double Decker Living Root Bridge Nongriat Meghalaya
places.bestTime: October to April (post-monsoon greens are lush; avoid monsoon floods)

places.name: Cherrapunji (Sohra) and Nohkalikai Falls
places.description: The tallest plunge waterfall in India, set in a landscape that makes the concept of rainfall feel elemental and overwhelming.
places.bestTime: Monsoon (June-September) for maximum flow; October-November for clear skies

places.name: Mawsmai Cave, Cherrapunji
places.description: Meghalaya's most visitor-friendly cave — a genuinely dramatic limestone system requiring no experience or gear.
places.bestTime: Morning to avoid crowds and for the freshest light at the cave mouth

places.name: Dawki River (Umngot River)
places.description: Arguably the clearest river in Asia — the sensation of floating above the riverbed in a boat defies belief.
places.mapsSearch: Dawki Umngot River Meghalaya boat ride
places.bestTime: November to April (post-monsoon transparency; during monsoon the river turns muddy)

places.name: Mawlynnong Village
places.description: A showcase of community-led sustainability and Khasi culture — proof that 'eco-village' is not just a concept but a living achievement.
places.bestTime: October to May (monsoon can make the sky walk access muddy)

places.name: Shillong Peak
places.description: The best panoramic viewpoint in Meghalaya — a 360-degree perspective over the state's extraordinary topography.
places.bestTime: Clear winter mornings (November to February) for cloud inversions and sunrise

places.name: Elephant Falls, Shillong
places.description: An easily accessible three-tiered waterfall just 12 km from Shillong — the perfect introduction to Meghalaya's waterfall landscape.
places.bestTime: Post-monsoon (September-October) for maximum volume and lush greenery

places.name: Ward's Lake, Shillong
places.description: The calm, leafy social heart of Shillong city — an old-world lakeside park perfect for an afternoon stroll.

places.name: Mawphlang Sacred Forest
places.description: One of India's best examples of indigenous conservation — a forest more ancient and biodiverse than most protected reserves.
places.bestTime: October to April; morning for birdlife

places.name: Laitlum Canyons
places.description: Meghalaya's most spectacular canyon landscape — as dramatic as any famous gorge in the world and nearly entirely crowd-free.
places.bestTime: Early morning when mist fills the valleys, or just after rain

budget.label: Budget
budget.blurb: Hostels or guesthouses, local food, public transport

midRange.label: Mid-range
midRange.blurb: Three-star hotels, a mix of restaurants, the odd taxi

comfortable.label: Comfortable
comfortable.blurb: Good four-star stays, restaurants by choice, tours
